Parent's actual local-loopback CDP probe independently recorded prompt plus successful coordinates without a grant. This is an additional concrete compatibility repair to include alongside the parent's other approved fixes/#1284. Open PR #1228 is a candidate but equates configured coordinates with granted permission, removes default coordinates, and leaves CDP grant no-op; do not conflate configuration with user/browser-context permission or accept that policy unchanged. No probe rerun by scout.

items.title: RFC: Persistent storage architecture (localStorage disk sync, ACID IndexedDB via redb, CacheStorage)
requirements: Origin-scoped localStorage disk persistence under --storage-dir with navigation/shutdown flushing.
Durable transactional IndexedDB including key ranges and cursor operations; RFC proposes pure-Rust redb.
Real persistent CacheStorage request/response headers and bodies.
items.reason: Complete body read. Native localStorage disk load/save is already implemented, unlike the issue's old bootstrap-only premise. IndexedDB is explicitly memory-only and CacheStorage is deliberately unadvertised; neither is covered by current transaction support. Durable IndexedDB and real CacheStorage are additional feature scope, not automatically part of repairing current in-memory semantics. Open PR #1158 is a candidate only, not current implementation or proven full conformance; any evaluation must preserve existing typed-key/structured-clone/transaction contracts rather than blindly replacing them. No storage runtime checks run in this scout.

items.title: DOM mutations from JS are slow (3 to 9 us per call, mostly bridge and bootstrap overhead)
requirements: Reduce JS DOM mutation and scalar-read bridge overhead without changing mutation, observer, script, stylesheet or named-property semantics
Avoid eager style allocation and unnecessary insertion scans
items.reason: New performance scope, not proof of a currently reproduced bug. Current Element construction still eagerly creates CSSStyleDeclaration plus Proxy and _domParse still JSON-parses string results. However the reported always-attached IntersectionObserver MutationObserver is obsolete: current observer scheduling is rendering-opportunity/checkpoint based and gates on active targets. Insertion paths also changed substantially. PR1156 is a relevant unmerged optimization proposal, not evidence all of it exists locally or that its timings transfer. Rebase/minimize and benchmark the actual current tree before adopting composite bridge fast paths.

items.title: text layout of large pages allocates far more than it keeps
items.requirements: Additional optional performance scope: avoid cloning full LayoutStyle per word, trim shaped buffer spare capacity, release finalized shape glyphs while supporting reshape on demand; shaping-plan caching alone is insufficient.
items.reason: The per-token full-style clone still exists and finalize retains its buffer. PR #1154 supplies a bounded candidate and explicitly reports first-layout latency within noise; this is memory optimization, not evidence that all large pages are currently slow. No local benchmark was run.

items.title: page loads on real sites are network-bound by serial subresource fetching
requirements: Enable HTTP/2 for regular reqwest transport
Overlap stylesheet and script download phases
Run ready scripts without waiting for the slowest unrelated script
items.reason: New latency scope partly already covered. Current reqwest enables http2, and current classic-script scheduler uses buffer_unordered(16), readiness polling and receive_classic rather than an all-downloads barrier. But navigate_single still awaits fetch_stylesheets, installs CSS and performs bounded resource warmup before execute_scripts constructs its download stream; stylesheet/script wave overlap remains absent in this path. PR1152 supplies a candidate but cannot be blindly applied over current parser/module readiness work. No live-site or local latency benchmark was run; claimed speedups remain upstream measurements, not this fork's results.

Shared mutation algorithms validate arguments/order and generate records; real document roots and Range mutations exist; CSS grouping/cache and IO interface/delivery fixes exist; inline-block block-flow has a dedicated regression. Original 22-file WPT corpus was not run here, and no current 165/169 or full conformance result is claimed. PR1142 is primary design/history evidence only; its reported validation is not this checkout's exercised evidence.

crates/obscura-js/tests/platform_behavior.rs:629-718 ownership, mutation records and validity assertions; 783-805 actual Range mutation assertions (read, not executed)

items.title: CDP Emulation.setTouchEmulationEnabled is a no-op; Emulation.setEmulatedMedia not implemented

Other feature names are silently ignored and the media type parameter is not read by this handler. Do not duplicate the two existing preference overrides; focus touch pointer/hover/maxTouchPoints policy and honest unsupported handling for unimplemented media overrides. Full gesture implementation is not implied by this issue.

Keep normal page transport/policy and prove unused protected URLs are never requested in a local OAuth-state fixture; disabling all CSS backgrounds is not a repair.
items.reason: Current render_resource_candidates still collects all style/inline/external stylesheet source text and enumerates css_resource_urls. prepare_screenshot_resources calls spawn_pending_render_resources, which starts those candidates through page transport. Later retained-render misses are selective but do not remove eager unused requests. This is a concrete remaining side-effect risk, not a spec-violation assertion or live SAP reproduction. PR #814 provides a candidate and local regression ideas.

items.title: Fetch interception blocks every matched subresource outright instead of pausing and asking the client
requirements: Keep Network.setBlockedURLs distinct from Fetch pause patterns
Actually pause static scripts/styles/imports before I/O and apply Continue/Fail/Fulfill
Bound abandoned interception without treating unapproved private URLs as authorized
items.reason: Existing interception compatibility scope: should_block_url now consults only blocked_url_patterns, so the original block-list conflation is covered. Static parser script fetch still directly calls the HTTP client, and CDP synthesizes un-intercepted resource requestPaused events from completed network records. Those are not decision-bearing pre-I/O pauses. PR644 is relevant but must integrate with newer native loading/cancellation boundaries. Its fail-open timeout proposal requires explicit policy review; it is not automatically accepted by this triage.

requirements: Computed getPropertyValue/item/cssText/length must not invoke declaration methods with corrupt proxy this
Serve computed method lookups before generic target passthrough
items.reason: Named method crash is already covered structurally: all reported methods/fields are handled directly before prop-in-target passthrough and compute from detachedLookup/native snapshot, avoiding _pull through an outer proxy. This does not claim every inherited CSSStyleDeclaration method is fully conformant or that the external WooCommerce page has been retested. No checks executed here.

crates/obscura-js/js/bootstrap.js:1774-1794 owner-backed declaration explains original failure path

items.title: Request: support --storage-dir in `obscura mcp` for persistent cookies/session
requirements: Pass a persistent profile into both stdio and HTTP MCP contexts.
Load/save cookies and origin localStorage after navigation and clean exit, including volume-mounted container use.
items.reason: Complete body and all four current comments read. CLI top-level --storage-dir is handed through OBSCURA_STORAGE_DIR; both transports construct the same storage-aware BrowserState, so the old completely-ignored-profile premise is already repaired. localStorage flushes after page scripts and stdio EOF saves both stores. However static callsite tracing finds ordinary MCP navigation does not save cookies, HTTP has no profile-save/shutdown branch, and post-navigation localStorage mutations are not guaranteed durable on HTTP exit. [INFERENCE] These leave the requested automatic cookie/HTTP lifecycle contract incomplete despite docs saying otherwise; needs offline restart/shutdown acceptance by parent, not a reproduced claim. Existing manual storage-state import saves both stores but is the workaround, not the requested automatic guarantee. Open PR #926 is candidate context only. Separate profiles remain required for independent processes; no cross-process database guarantee.

items.title: In the screenshot, Chinese text cannot be displayed properly
items.requirements: Already covered for fork font discovery/configuration and shared text/control/SVG fallback when CJK fonts are available; preserve readable painted glyphs, not just nonzero advance. Do not imply a fontless container has bundled CJK fonts or that all Baidu layout is browser-identical.
items.reason: Issue comments identify deliberately embedded-only fonts and separately bypassed native-control paint. Current source discovers system fonts by default, supports configured directories, and shares the font policy. Existing delivery documentation records fresh Windows original CJK counterexamples and 91/92-case CLI/CDP/MCP/scrape/control/SVG font-policy acceptance. This is source plus recorded prior verification, not a newly exercised screenshot. Fontless hosts still require installed/configured glyph coverage.

items.title: `setExtraHTTPHeaders` not working with stealth
requirements: CDP extra page headers reach native stealth document requests
Keep page header ownership and credential stripping intact
items.reason: Already covered by explicit current-source plumbing: Network handler calls Page::set_extra_headers, which updates both clients; stealth GET request construction applies extra_headers, with deliberate filtering for origin/referrer and credential boundaries. No postman-echo request or local wire test performed; this does not claim every unrelated subresource uses stealth (see #977).

items.title: serve mode: Target.getTargets empty on fresh browser connection — puppeteer.connect sees no pages
requirements: Expose an initial real about:blank page consistently through HTTP discovery and browser Target.getTargets
Emit existing targetCreated notifications when discovery starts
items.reason: High-value new compatibility scope related to existing680 endpoint repair, not already fixed by current target discovery implementation. New per-connection CdpContext starts pages empty, normal NewConnection creates no page, Target.getTargets enumerates that empty list, while /json always advertises page-1. setDiscoverTargets now emits existing local pages (and browser) correctly, but cannot invent the absent initial page. Fix truthful bootstrap target identity/discovery together; source-only finding, no Puppeteer run.
items.parent_runtime_observation: Parent fresh browser Target.getTargets returns empty and creator page remains invisible to another connection; target-discovery.json. This does not establish every default-page policy requirement.

items.title: `request.continue()` overrides are silently dropped for all intercepted requests
requirements: Apply URL/method/header/body overrides before network I/O for top-level navigation and every intercepted resource
Decode CDP postData as bytes and revalidate rewritten URL at existing private-network/origin gate
items.reason: Existing interception compatibility scope: live fetch/XHR Continue now forwards all four fields, and op_fetch_url applies them with rewrite validation. The claim 'all overrides dropped' is no longer globally true. Top-level and static-resource paths still fetch directly and emit some requestPaused events after completed records, so all-resource/top-level acceptance remains incomplete. Existing navigation-interception unit tests inject an InterceptedRequest and prove servicing, not real top-level request rewriting. No end-to-end wire reproduction run.

items.title: Target.getTargets returns empty for new connections — pages not globally visible (CDP spec violation)
requirements: Expose shared browser target identity/visibility across connections without sharing cookies or other context state
Route operations to owning page/context and preserve V8 thread affinity
items.reason: New architecture-level compatibility scope overlapping570/680 but broader than their initial-page/endpoint fixes. Current processor owns per-connection CdpContext and page Vec; getTargets and attachToTarget inspect only those pages. A new connection cannot enumerate/attach another connection's targets. Body's proposed existing global v8_lock is outdated: current lock is deliberately per-connection and each processor is on its own thread. A shared metadata registry plus owner-thread command routing (not moving V8 Page across threads or merely publishing inaccessible target IDs) is needed for real global semantics. No architecture change or cross-connection runtime check performed.
items.parent_runtime_observation: Parent created page is visible on creator browser WebSocket but absent from second connection Target.getTargets; target-discovery.json.

items.title: [Feature] Configurable module evaluation timeout, DOM.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded CDP support, and V8 watchdog tuning for complex SPA hydration
requirements: Configurable module evaluation budget for Vite/SPA boot
Tune synchronous watchdog without disabling runaway-JS safety
Implement DOM.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded
Provide screenshots when render-enabled
items.reason: Most old feature requests are statically covered: OBSCURA_MODULE_BUDGET_MS exists with shell-aware budget policy, OBSCURA_SCRIPT_DEADLINE_MS configures the script phase, DOM.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded resolves the native node and runs real nested-scrollport handling, and captureScreenshot has a native render pipeline. Remaining watchdog configurability is real: execute_script_guarded still applies a fixed5s timeout to scripts>=10000bytes, and autonomous tasks retain fixed5000ms+500ms safety constants. Increasing only module/phase settings does not raise that classic-script limit. No current Astro/Vue/Vite repro is supplied or exercised; targeted configurable bounded per-task policy is optional new tuning scope until justified, while no-watchdog and no-op scrolling suggestions are not recommended.

items.title: canvas / WebGL / AudioContext fingerprint support
requirements: Issue body requests JavaScript rendering of gongkaoleida template variables, not a concrete Canvas/WebGL/Audio requirement
Obtain authorized reduced offline reproduction and failing script/network boundary before choosing a repair
items.reason: Body/title mismatch must not be silently converted into fingerprint-spoofing scope. Complete body only reports unresolved articleInfo placeholders at an external URL, with no log or Chrome comparison. Comment explicitly confirms the mismatch and discusses a separate fork's rendering/HTTP heuristic; it is not evidence current fork is fixed. Missing prerequisite is a local/authorized reduced fixture or retained script/network trace identifying the failing template step. No third-party target contacted.

items.title: Obscura doesn't automatically fallback to direct access when server on `HTTP_PROXY`/`HTTPS_PROXY` is down
requirements: Assess requested automatic direct fallback against explicit proxy confidentiality
Keep proxy failure closed; improve diagnostics separately only if requested
items.reason: Do not adopt the requested automatic fallback: a configured proxy is an operator routing/confidentiality boundary and direct retry can reveal the originating address and bypass policy. The issue itself says Chrome also fails. Current clients install the configured proxy without an automatic direct retry in the inspected constructors; preserve that behavior and the native transport/private-network gates. This is a rejected behavioral proposal, not an uninvestigated networking bug or a request to contact the cited site.

items.title: navigator.userAgent contradicts the User-Agent request header on every platform
requirements: Keep HTTP UA, client hints, navigator UA/platform coherent across ordinary and native transports and overrides
Separate coherence from a product decision to default persona to actual host OS
items.reason: Existing identity scope: default ordinary context seeds the HTTP UA from one profile and seeds runtime UA/platform from that context; default stealth uses matching Chrome145 Windows constants and runtime platform. Thus historical 'every default platform contradicts' is not established today; issue comments also report Windows coverage. Remaining scope is custom UA/profile/override coherence: context platform is selected independently of explicit UA; stealth Page construction does not seed its UA from context; CDP override updates UA in both clients/live runtime but not platform here. Default-to-host behavior is a separate optional policy choice, not necessary for coherent privacy persona. No live anti-bot testing.
